# Release 6.4.0 — 2026-11-09

## Summary

ycc 6.4.0 adds the `mcp-parity` skill for planning and syncing a Linear project with one issue per API/app capability, maps the Haiku model tier to `@task` for OMP, and pins the OMP `unpin` built-in so the OMP built-in command check passes.

## Added

- `mcp-parity` skill (`/ycc:mcp-parity`) researches a repo's API or app surface and creates or syncs a Linear project, milestones, and prioritized issues for one-to-one MCP parity. Re-runs apply only the delta (added, changed, removed, revived) via a manifest Document, with deterministic diffing in `capability_diff.py`, OpenAPI 3.x inventories via `openapi_inventory.py`, and surface hints from `detect-api-surface.sh` (#540, closes #539).
- OMP model policy: `haiku` maps to `@task`, and `code-finder` now runs on `haiku`.

## Changed

- `code-finder` agent model: `sonnet` → `haiku`.

## Removed

- None this release.

## Fixed

- OMP built-in command pin: `unpin` is now in the reserved-name set in `scripts/generate_omp_commands.py`, so `scripts/omp_builtin_commands.py` passes against the live `omp` (18.18.1).

# Release 6.3.1 — 2026-11-05

## Summary

ycc 6.3.1 fixes duplicate ycc skills, agents, commands and MCP servers in opencode. `install` and `sync --target opencode` now add the `@yandy-r/ycc-opencode` npm plugin to `opencode.json` instead of copying the bundle into `~/.config/opencode`, and retire the old copies that ycc can prove it wrote.

## Added

- `install --target opencode` writes one `plugins` entry. `--mode local` (default) points it at this checkout's `packages/opencode/ycc-opencode`; `--mode repo` pins `@yandy-r/ycc-opencode@<version>` from npm. `--package @yandy-r/ycc-opencode` does the same.

## Changed

- `@yandy-r/ycc-opencode` is now the primary opencode package (no longer experimental or opt-in). Settings, rules (`AGENTS.md`) and the opt-in plugin catalog stay on the installer.
- The generated `.opencode-plugin/opencode.json` no longer lists the `./ycc-sensitive-guard` plugin or an `mcp` block; the package ships both.
- Release notes no longer mark the npm package "not yet published".

## Removed

- opencode file copies (skills, agents, commands, shared helpers, the guard directory) and the opencode MCP merge.
- `--mcps`, `--agents`, `--commands`, `list-mcps`, `--skills-home` and its duplicate-skills prompt. `--skills` and `--with-deps` now apply to the agents target only.

## Fixed

da778507 fix(opencode)!: install the @yandy-r/ycc-opencode npm plugin instead of copying the bundle (YAN-1973) (#536)

- A ycc-written, bare or `@latest` `@yandy-r/ycc-opencode` entry is replaced in place, keeping its `options`. A pinned version you set yourself, or another checkout's directory, is kept unless you pass `--force`.
- The legacy cleanup runs only after the package is confirmed loadable: `package.json` in local mode, the npm release in repo mode, and opencode 2.0.30 or later when `opencode` is on PATH. It removes only byte-identical copies, owned `mcp.servers` entries and the owned guard item. Edited and foreign entries are kept, and a symlinked `opencode.json` is refused.

# Release 6.3.0 — 2026-11-05

## Summary

ycc 6.3.0 makes `install.sh` native-only. `install` and `sync` now install Claude, Codex and Cursor through their plugin CLIs (`ycc-mcp@ycc` and `ycc-hooks@ycc` included), and they clean up files left by older installs, but only files ycc can prove it wrote. The legacy file-copy and config-merge routes and the `migrate` subcommand are gone.

## Added

977fbb65 feat(install)!: install natively only; drop legacy install routes (YAN-1962) (#534)

- Claude: `--intent mcp` installs `ycc-mcp@ycc` and `--intent hooks` installs `ycc-hooks@ycc`, at project scope by default and user scope with `--global`. This fixes `refusing to replace directory with symlink: ~/.claude/hooks`.
- Codex: `base` installs `ycc@ycc` and `ycc-mcp@ycc` with `codex plugin add`, and `--intent mcp` installs `ycc-mcp@ycc`.
- Cursor: `install` registers the GitHub marketplace with `agent plugin marketplace add` and lists which packages to select in `/plugins`.
- OMP: old `omp plugin link` and marketplace installs are cleaned up during `install`.

## Changed

- The legacy cleanup (formerly `migrate --apply`) runs as part of install, sync and `remove --intent base`. It removes only files identical to what ycc wrote, links ycc owns, and config entries ycc recorded. Edited copies and your own files are kept and reported. If the cleanup fails, it prints a warning and the install continues.

## Removed

977fbb65 feat(install)!: install natively only; drop legacy install routes (YAN-1962) (#534)

- The `migrate` subcommand (`--apply`, `--marketplace-source`) and the deprecation hints.
- Claude: the `~/.claude/hooks` symlink, the settings `hooks` merge, the MCP merge into `~/.claude.json` / `.mcp.json`, and standalone skill, agent and command copies.
- Codex: the `local-ycc-plugins` catalog, plugin symlinks, cache copies for Codex builds older than 0.160, the `[mcp_servers]` merge and standalone skill copies.
- Cursor: every file copy (skills, agents, commands, rules bundle, the hooks carrier, the MCP merge).
- `--skills`, `--agents`, `--commands`, `--mcps`, `--with-deps`, `--skills-home` and `--hooks <events>` for claude, codex, cursor and omp. They still apply to opencode and agents.

## Fixed

- `remove --target cursor --intent <content>` no longer drops the whole ycc marketplace; only `--intent base` does.

# Release 6.2.1 — 2026-11-04

## Summary

ycc 6.2.1 removes the `linear-personal` MCP server from `ycc-mcp` on every runtime; `linear` is now the only Linear server. It also fixes saved `external_directory` approvals in the opencode npm package and a CRLF `.gitignore` check in branch prep, and registers the deferred Pi target in the package model.

## Added

9c420dfd feat(packages): register pi target in model, capability matrix and audits (YAN-1183) (#529)
8950f6b3 feat(scripts): harden live-harness bwrap sandbox with a shared layout (YAN-1905) (#524)

## Changed

None this release.

## Removed

30f34598 chore(mcp): remove linear-personal MCP server (YAN-1943) (#532)

## Fixed

a4c001ea fix(omp): assert version-appropriate cache GC in the install-lifecycle harness (YAN-1927) (#526)
2c325433 fix(branch-prep): accept the cache-rule .gitignore append on CRLF checkouts (YAN-1878) (#523)

# Release 6.2.0 — 2026-11-04

## Summary

ycc 6.2.0 adds the artifact store: planning, implementation, review and report skills can keep their artifacts as Linear documents and issues (with a local `.ycc/artifacts/` cache) instead of `docs/plans` and `docs/prps` files, and `ycc:init` records the choice in a committed pointer. Linear is now the default store for repositories without a store configuration; existing local plans and reviews keep working. `install.sh` gains `--dry-run` on every target and step, and project scope for the settings step and Claude hooks.
